description.value: Ruby Alton Nature Reserve is a conserved natural area on Salt Spring Island, protected and managed by the Islands Trust Conservancy to preserve biodiversity and natural habitat. It represents the kind of undeveloped green space that makes Gulf Island cycling distinctive, offering touring cyclists a chance to experience the islands' natural character away from developed areas.
